import copy
import unittest
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

from solution import generate_manifest, validate_manifest


class ManifestTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_generation_sorts_sources_and_fields_and_normalizes_locators(self):
        config = {
            "name": "demo & test",
            "sources": [
                {
                    "name": "zeta",
                    "kind": "coverage",
                    "locator": "  https://example.test/zeta///  ",
                    "profile": "harmonized",
                    "fields": {"z": "last", "a": "first"},
                },
                {
                    "name": "alpha",
                    "kind": "tiles",
                    "locator": "bucket/path/",
                    "profile": "plain",
                    "fields": {},
                },
            ],
        }
        xml_text = generate_manifest(config)
        self.assertFalse(xml_text.startswith("<?xml"))
        root = ET.fromstring(xml_text)
        self.assertEqual(root.tag, "manifest")
        self.assertEqual(root.attrib, {"name": "demo & test"})
        sources = list(root)
        self.assertEqual([item.attrib["name"] for item in sources], ["alpha", "zeta"])
        self.assertEqual(list(sources[0].attrib), ["name", "kind", "profile"])
        self.assertEqual(sources[0].find("locator").text, "bucket/path")
        self.assertEqual(sources[1].find("locator").text, "https://example.test/zeta")
        fields = sources[1].findall("field")
        self.assertEqual([(f.attrib["key"], f.text) for f in fields], [("a", "first"), ("z", "last")])
        self.assertLess(xml_text.index('name="alpha"'), xml_text.index('name="zeta"'))
        self.assertLess(xml_text.index('key="a"'), xml_text.index('key="z"'))

    def test_xml_escaping_and_empty_lists(self):
        config = {"name": "<&\"", "sources": []}
        xml_text = generate_manifest(config)
        self.assertEqual(ET.fromstring(xml_text).attrib["name"], "<&\"")
        self.assertTrue(validate_manifest(xml_text))

        config = {
            "name": "special",
            "sources": [{
                "name": "s&1",
                "kind": "features",
                "locator": "x<&y",
                "profile": "plain",
                "fields": {"a&b": "<& value", "empty": ""},
            }],
        }
        xml_text = generate_manifest(config)
        root = ET.fromstring(xml_text)
        source = root[0]
        self.assertEqual(source.attrib["name"], "s&1")
        self.assertEqual(source[0].text, "x<&y")
        self.assertEqual(source[1].attrib["key"], "a&b")
        self.assertEqual(source[1].text, "<& value")
        self.assertTrue(validate_manifest(xml_text))

    def test_generation_does_not_mutate_or_retain_config(self):
        config = {
            "name": "stable",
            "sources": [{
                "name": "source",
                "kind": "tiles",
                "locator": " location/// ",
                "profile": "plain",
                "fields": {"b": "2", "a": "1"},
            }],
        }
        snapshot = copy.deepcopy(config)
        generated = generate_manifest(config)
        self.assertEqual(config, snapshot)
        config["sources"][0]["fields"]["a"] = "changed"
        self.assertTrue(validate_manifest(generated))
        self.assertEqual(ET.fromstring(generated)[0].findall("field")[0].text, "1")

    def test_config_container_and_scalar_type_errors(self):
        for config in (None, [], "config"):
            with self.subTest(config=config):
                with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
                    generate_manifest(config)
        invalid = [
            {"name": 1, "sources": []},
            {"name": "m", "sources": {}},
            {"name": "m", "sources": [1]},
            {"name": "m", "sources": [{"name": 1, "kind": "tiles", "locator": "x", "profile": "plain", "fields": {}}]},
            {"name": "m", "sources": [{"name": "s", "kind": 1, "locator": "x", "profile": "plain", "fields": {}}]},
            {"name": "m", "sources": [{"name": "s", "kind": "tiles", "locator": 1, "profile": "plain", "fields": {}}]},
            {"name": "m", "sources": [{"name": "s", "kind": "tiles", "locator": "x", "profile": 1, "fields": {}}]},
            {"name": "m", "sources": [{"name": "s", "kind": "tiles", "locator": "x", "profile": "plain", "fields": []}]},
            {"name": "m", "sources": [{"name": "s", "kind": "tiles", "locator": "x", "profile": "plain", "fields": {1: "v"}}]},
            {"name": "m", "sources": [{"name": "s", "kind": "tiles", "locator": "x", "profile": "plain", "fields": {"k": 1}}]},
        ]
        for config in invalid:
            with self.subTest(config=config):
                with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
                    generate_manifest(config)

    def test_invalid_configuration_values(self):
        base_source = {"name": "s", "kind": "tiles", "locator": "x", "profile": "plain", "fields": {}}
        invalid = [
            {},
            {"name": "m", "sources": [], "extra": True},
            {"name": "", "sources": []},
            {"name": "m", "sources": [{}]},
            {"name": "m", "sources": [{**base_source, "extra": "x"}]},
            {"name": "m", "sources": [{**base_source, "name": ""}]},
            {"name": "m", "sources": [{**base_source, "kind": "unknown"}]},
            {"name": "m", "sources": [{**base_source, "profile": "other"}]},
            {"name": "m", "sources": [{**base_source, "locator": " ///  "}]},
            {"name": "m", "sources": [{**base_source, "fields": {"": "value"}}]},
            {"name": "m", "sources": [base_source, dict(base_source)]},
        ]
        for config in invalid:
            with self.subTest(config=config):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    generate_manifest(config)

    def test_validator_rejects_non_strings_and_malformed_xml(self):
        for value in (None, 1, b"<manifest/>", {}, "", "<manifest>"):
            with self.subTest(value=value):
                self.assertFalse(validate_manifest(value))

    def test_validator_rejects_structural_violations(self):
        invalid_xml = [
            '<other name="m" />',
            '<manifest />',
            '<manifest name="" />',
            '<manifest name="m" extra="x" />',
            '<manifest name="m"><extra /></manifest>',
            '<manifest name="m"><source name="s" kind="bad" profile="plain"><locator>x</locator></source></manifest>',
            '<manifest name="m"><source name="s" kind="tiles" profile="bad"><locator>x</locator></source></manifest>',
            '<manifest name="m"><source name="s" kind="tiles" profile="plain" extra="x"><locator>x</locator></source></manifest>',
            '<manifest name="m"><source name="s" kind="tiles" profile="plain"></source></manifest>',
            '<manifest name="m"><source name="s" kind="tiles" profile="plain"><field key="a">v</field><locator>x</locator></source></manifest>',
            '<manifest name="m"><source name="s" kind="tiles" profile="plain"><locator> x </locator></source></manifest>',
            '<manifest name="m"><source name="s" kind="tiles" profile="plain"><locator>x/</locator></source></manifest>',
            '<manifest name="m"><source name="s" kind="tiles" profile="plain"><locator>x</locator><field key=""></field></source></manifest>',
            '<manifest name="m"><source name="s" kind="tiles" profile="plain"><locator>x</locator><field key="a" extra="x">v</field></source></manifest>',
            '<manifest name="m"><source name="s" kind="tiles" profile="plain"><locator>x</locator><field key="b">1</field><field key="a">2</field></source></manifest>',
            '<manifest name="m"><source name="s" kind="tiles" profile="plain"><locator>x</locator><field key="a">1</field><field key="a">2</field></source></manifest>',
            '<manifest name="m"><source name="z" kind="tiles" profile="plain"><locator>x</locator></source><source name="a" kind="tiles" profile="plain"><locator>y</locator></source></manifest>',
            '<manifest name="m"><source name="a" kind="tiles" profile="plain"><locator>x</locator></source><source name="a" kind="features" profile="plain"><locator>y</locator></source></manifest>',
        ]
        for xml_text in invalid_xml:
            with self.subTest(xml_text=xml_text):
                self.assertFalse(validate_manifest(xml_text))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
